attacks.name: Stormbreaker
steps: After this attack is resolved, this character gains |!power| equal to the |!damage| dealt.
|!wild| |*Stun|: After this attack is resolved, the defender gains the |§stun§Stun| special condition.

attacks.name: Summon the Storm
steps: If the defender has the Flight |!innate| superpower, this character may reroll up to 2 of its attack dice, including |!failure| results.
|!wild| |*Shock|: After this attack is resolved, the defender gains the |§shock§Shock| special condition.

attacks.name: Godhunter
steps: Add dice to the attack roll equal to the defender's |!size|.
|!critical| |!wild| |!hit| |*Hurl|: After this attack is resolved, Throw the defender |!range_medium|.

superPowers.name: Immeasurable Strength
superPowers.body: Choose an interactive terrain feature or an enemy character, both of |!size| 4 or less and within |!range| 2, and Throw it |!range_medium|. This superpower can be used only once per Turn.

superPowers.name: Korbinite Cybernetics
superPowers.body: If this character would suffer |!damage|, it may use this superpower. Reduce the amount of |!damage| suffered by 1.

superPowers.name: Honorbound
superPowers.body: After an attack targeting this character is resolved, if this character suffered |!damage|, it may Advance |!range_small| Toward the attacker.

superPowers.name: Blessed by the All-Father
superPowers.body: During the |*Power Phase|, this character gains 1 additional |!power|.
